sources.entry: Gotenberg - Developer-friendly API to interact with powerful tools like Chromium and LibreOffice for converting numerous document formats (HTML, Markdown, Word, Excel, etc.) into PDF files, and more. (Source Code) MIT Docker
Gotenberg | Docker-powered API for converting documents to PDF

summary.one_liner: Gotenberg is a Docker-based API that converts documents to PDF and performs other PDF operations by accepting files via multipart/form-data.
summary.what_it_does: Gotenberg runs as a Docker container exposing an HTTP API on port 3000 in the quick start example. Clients send files or URLs with multipart/form-data and receive a PDF back. HTML, URLs and Markdown are rendered to PDF through headless Chromium, and Office documents are converted through LibreOffice (the README says 100+ formats). The README also lists PDF operations: merge, split, rotate, flatten, watermark, stamp, encrypt, PDF/A and PDF/UA compliance, screenshots of URLs and HTML, and reading or writing metadata and bookmarks. The README states users do not need to manage Chromium, LibreOffice or fonts themselves.
use_cases: convert URLs to PDF such as invoices
convert Word or Excel files to PDF
merge, split, or watermark PDFs via an API
notable: Office-to-PDF conversion via LibreOffice, with the README citing 100+ formats
HTML and URL rendering through headless Chromium
Merge, split, rotate, flatten, watermark, stamp and encrypt PDF operations
Read and write PDF metadata and bookmarks
caveats: The README does not list platform requirements or resource needs beyond Docker
Advanced details are in an external documentation site not included in the README
